name: What types of replacement windows are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of replacement windows are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacement windows come in various types, each offering different benefits. Common options include double-hung, casement, sliding, picture, and bay or bow windows. Materials typically include vinyl, wood, fiberglass, and aluminum. Vinyl windows are popular for their affordability and low maintenance, while wood offers a classic aesthetic and good insulation. Fiberglass is durable and energy-efficient, and aluminum is strong and slim, often used in modern designs. The best choice depends on your home's style, budget, and desired performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include double-hung, casement, and sliding, available in materials like vinyl, wood, fiberglass, or aluminum.
